# 南山祖師禮讚文

**ID:** X1505
**Volume:** X74
**Category:** 律部類
**Original Category:** 禮懺部
**Byline:** 宋 仁岳述
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 1

## Contributors
- 仁岳 (A000106)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Northern-Sòng *lǐzàn wén* 禮讚文 for the death-anniversary of **Nánshān Dàoxuān** 南山道宣 (596–667), composed by **Jìngjué Rényuè** 淨覺仁岳 ([仁岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%B2%B3), 992–ca. 1064), the *Zháchuān shāmén* 霅川沙門 — i.e. monk of *Zháxī* 霅谿 (Wúxīng 吳興). Author signature: *Zháchuān shāmén shì Rényuè shù* 霅川沙門釋　仁岳　述. The work is the **second** of the three Sòng *Nánshān lǐzàn wén* preserved in the Xùzàngjīng (X1504, [KR6k0207](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0207) = Zhìyuán; X1505, this work = Rényuè; X1506, [KR6k0209](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0209) = Yǔnkǎn).

**Abstract**

Rényuè's *Nánshān zǔshī lǐzàn wén* is structurally parallel to Zhìyuán's: an *yīxīn fèngqǐng* 一心奉請 invocation, prostrations, eulogy verses keyed to Dàoxuān's biographical episodes (the descent of relics into a precious casket at *Rìyán jīngshè* 日嚴精舍, the transmission of the fourpart *vinaya*, etc.), with closing offerings. Where Zhìyuán wrote the prototype, Rényuè's contribution is principally **liturgical**: he set the eulogy in chantable verse-and-prose alternation, and supplied the metrical *zàn* stanzas that became standard in Sòngonward Vinayaschool anniversary services. Rényuè's life is bracketed 992–ca. 1064 ; the *zànwén* must postdate his break with *Sìmíng Zhīlǐ* 四明知禮 (after ca. 1020) and predate his death — `notBefore` and `notAfter` are accordingly set 1020–1064. Rényuè was best known for his *Shí bùèr mén wénxīn jiě* 十不二門文心解 ([KR6d0162](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0162), X928), the cardinal *shānwài* tract of the Sòng Tiāntái doctrinal controversy.
